contract.objective: Read-only integrity audit of Chohogi: whether documented skills, agents, scripts and chains exist, are discovered, are invoked correctly, and hand off correctly across chained steps.
requested: integrity criterion first: layer A static cross-reference, then chain trace tables for the five chains, as an evidence table by criterion
excluded: any fix to Chohogi assets (proposals only; fixes need separate homeostasis admission)
raw prompts or private reasoning in records

requestedItems.description: Static definition-vs-existence cross-reference, classified by document authority, plus manifest registration comparison.
Trace tables for entry, delegation, record, feedback-loop, and model chains across layers B-E with observed evidence.
Evidence table by criterion with confirmed/unconfirmed causes and proposed fixes.

acceptance.description: Every reported finding cites a file:line or command output observed in this session.
